bibliographic.title: A Near Dawn: Text Prototype
bibliographic.author: Leonid Pilchin
bibliographic.description:
A Near Dawn is now a graphical adventure game, but it started out as a text-based adventure two years ago.

I discovered Twine and began writing my story about a driven and desperate Seattle attorney, trying to help his mentor save his firm.

Though I developed a good half of the game in Twine before switching to Ren'Py and going graphical with it, I decided to end this version where the graphical Prologue currently ends. Unfortunately it does not advance too far, but if you have a look at the graphical adventure some time, you can see how far we've come with this project.

Graphical: https://faroffdaydream.itch.io/a-near-dawn
